description: This file defines the React context and hooks for authentication in a gym management web application. It provides an AuthProvider component, custom hooks for accessing auth state, and functions for signing in with email and Google OAuth, as well as signing out.

methods.name: AuthProvider
methods.description: React functional component providing authentication context to its children, managing user session state, and exposing sign-in and sign-out methods.

methods.name: useAuth
methods.description: Custom React hook to access the authentication context, ensuring it is used within an AuthProvider.

methods.name: useRole
methods.description: Custom React hook to derive the current user role from session's user metadata.

methods.name: useSupabaseAuth
methods.description: Alias hook for useAuth, maintained for backward compatibility.
